about:
Founded in 2011 by Freddie Provenzano in Colorado Springs, Colorado, Eden Oaks began as a small operation run out of a storage unit. The company has since expanded to a 20,000-square-foot woodworking shop employing 25 full-time craftsmen and professionals.

Eden Oaks operates as a full-service design and build firm, providing custom and semi-custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, furniture, and casework. The in-house team handles design, material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and installation, working with domestic hardwoods, reclaimed wood, metals, finishes, and epoxy resin. The facility produces a range of products including cabinets, countertops, islands, tables, bars, stair treads, doors, beams, accent walls, railings, mantels, and floating shelves.

The company serves both residential and commercial clients across Colorado and beyond. Residential work includes private homes, while commercial projects span restaurants, offices, hospitality spaces, and multi-unit developments. Eden Oaks collaborates directly with homeowners, interior designers, builders, and general contractors throughout the project lifecycle.

The firm emphasizes durability, precision, and thoughtful design, aiming to integrate the natural character of Colorado into each space. By managing the entire process from concept through installation, Eden Oaks seeks to ensure consistency and accountability, distinguishing itself through the use of eco-friendly materials and a curated showroom experience.
